tasks.title: Conversation #48
tasks.transcript:
Man：What main dish should we prepare for our dinner party this weekend?
Woman：The steak we ate at your parents’ place last week was fabulous. We could do something similar.
Man：Hmm, I don’t think the Johnsons eat meat. I was thinking more along the lines of veggie lasagna.
Woman：Oh, I do have a great recipe for that actually.
Man：We have a winner then. I’ll need the list of ingredients for my trip to the supermarket tonight.

questions.stem: Why does the woman mention the man’s parents?

options.A: To identify people that should be invited
options.B: To request an item from the supermarket
options.C: To explain the source of a lasagna recipe
options.D: To propose a dish for a party

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士为什么提到男士的父母，属于组织结构题，需结合上下文理解她举例的用意。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 女士提到的是在男士父母家吃的牛排，而非建议邀请他们参加聚会，属于无中生有。 选项B：错误。 对话末尾男士要去超市购物，但女士提到男士父母时并非为了索要超市商品。 选项C：错误。 千层面的食谱是女士自己拥有的（I do have a great recipe for that actually），而非来自男士父母。 选项D：正确。 男士问周末晚餐聚会准备什么主菜，女士说“The steak we ate at your parents' place last week was fabulous. We could do something similar.”，她提到男士父母是为了举例说明一种可行的主菜选择，即提议做类似牛排的菜品。

questions.stem: What will the man most likely do in the evening?
questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士晚上最可能做什么，属于预测题，需抓住男士在对话末尾明确表达的计划。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 男士明确说“I'll need the list of ingredients for my trip to the supermarket tonight”，说明他晚上最可能去超市购买食材。 选项B：错误。 对话中提到约翰逊一家不吃肉，但并未表示男士要和他们沟通，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 最终决定做蔬菜千层面，而非牛排，男士不需要做牛排。 选项D：错误。 对话中没有提到男士要去看望父母，属于无关干扰。
